title: T10 — Project WBS (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Project WBS — T10 SAFe cadence and MSP tranches

## Work packages

| Deliverable | Business value | Time criticality | Risk reduction | Job size | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SAFe cadence and MSP tranches — WSJF materialisation, demo evidence, retro lessons, tranche review and benefit realisation | 8 | 7 | 8 | 8 | accepted |

WSJF = (8+7+8)/8 = 2.875, computed from the four integers and never stored (§8.2).

## Acceptance

The project's §12 gate is the acceptance: PI planning materialises cards from the backlog by
computed WSJF within the WIP slots only after the plan is approved; a deliverable without typed
evidence cannot demo; a retro cannot close without a lesson; an end-of-tranche review without
baselines, benefit status or risk evidence is refused; a transition that never measured its
baseline cannot report the benefit realised. Each clause is proved by a named test
(`crates/store/tests/programme_cadence.rs`, `demo_gate.rs`, `retro.rs`, `tranche_review.rs`,
`benefit_transition.rs`) and the retrospective review records the deviations it admits.

## Status

Accepted as the retrospective WBS deliverable; the project's acceptance instrument is
`acceptance/programme/T10.toml`. Eight V1 findings remain open against T10 and are not waived.
